Calculates the nabla, or laplacian, of the elevation in each cell: the sum of its second derivatives in two perpendicular directions, which measures the curvature of the terrain. Positive values mark concave sites, as valleys, negative values convex sites, as ridges. With a threshold, it creates a mask of the convex sites instead.

**Toolbox folder:** Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Geomorphology, Nabla, Gradient<br>
**Authors:** Antonello Andrea, Daniele Andreis, Erica Ghesla, Cozzini Andrea, Franceschi Silvia, Pisoni Silvano, Rigon Riccardo<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Nabla`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inElev` | raster file |  |  | The map of the digital elevation model (DEM or pit). |
| `pThreshold` | Double |  |  | An optional threshold on the nabla, in 1/m: if set, the output is the mask of the cells with a nabla below minus the threshold. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outNabla` | output file |  | The map of the nabla, in 1/m, or the mask of the convex sites if a threshold is set. |
